shortBulletSummary: JPMorgan reports 20% of Bitcoin miners are unprofitable as BTC trades below its $78K production cost.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has dropped to 13, signaling "Extreme Fear" among investors.
The Federal Reserve's hawkish stance suggests "higher for longer" interest rates, strengthening the USD and pressuring crypto markets.
US-Iran peace talks were postponed amid renewed Israel-Hezbollah fighting, triggering over $192 million in crypto liquidations.
Both US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs continue to experience net outflows, indicating sustained institutional caution.
